name: Kaikidan Saishuuya
source:
Collection of 30 stories, featuring summer "ghost" theme. Those stories are based on people's experience, turned into sound novel.
Ghost story, Kansai ghost spot map, 7 wonders, etc.
It will take you to the true horror experience.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE046584.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
收录30个故事，以夏日“鬼”为主题。这些故事是根据人们的经历改编成的有声小说。
鬼故事、关西鬼点地图、七大奇迹等
它将带你体验真正的恐怖。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE046584.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
